integrity: A complete formal-series and two-adic polynomial proof is supplied. Direct recurrence computations independently corroborate a finite sample but are not a proof of the universal quantifiers. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Even bases only, uncolored unrestricted power partitions, indices of the form m^r n-1, first normalized binary digit only. A stronger unindexed result could conceivably imply the same statement; independently reviewed publication priority is not established.
title: Depth-stable dyadic leading digits of even-base power partitions
